title: Seaside Serenity
meta_description: Find the perfect 30A, FL vacation rental at “Seaside Serenity”, a Gulf Front luxury 5-bed, 5.5-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 14 guests, this home offers a Private Pool & Spa, Game Room, Elevator & Golf Cart for your enjoyment. Book your stay now!
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Gulf front - Panoramic Gulf views - Private Pool and sitting spa (Heating available for an additional $40 per day during the months of Oct 31-May 1) - Private beach entrance - Summer kitchen with gas grill - 6-seater Golf Cart - 6 adult bikes Discover Seaside Serenity, a breathtaking retreat set directly on the Gulf in Seagrove Beach. Designed to host up to 14 guests across 5 bedrooms and 5.5 bathrooms, this residence offers the perfect balance of sophistication and comfort for families and groups seeking a high-end 30A getaway. Every detail invites relaxation, from the sparkling private pool and spa to the exclusive beach access just steps from the back deck. Mornings begin with soft sea breezes, afternoons are for lounging by the water, and evenings bring unforgettable sunsets over the Gulf, all from the privacy of your own home. Inside, coastal-inspired design pairs crisp finishes with thoughtful touches. The expansive main living area features soaring ceilings, elegant wainscoting, and an entire wall of glass doors that frame sweeping ocean views. The kitchen is built for both casual meals and culinary experiences, complete with luxury appliances, a wine cooler, ice maker, and breakfast bar seating for six. Share meals around the 12-seat dining table, then relax in the adjoining lounge with plush seating and a large Smart TV. Step outside to an entertainer’s paradise. A covered patio overlooks the Gulf, complete with an outdoor kitchen, built-in gas grill, and plenty of seating for dining al fresco. Whether you’re floating in the pool, soaking in the spa, or enjoying the sound of waves, the outdoor spaces are designed to make every moment memorable. When it’s time to rest, five beautifully appointed bedrooms ensure privacy and comfort. The main-level suite includes a king bed, spa-style bathroom, and direct deck access. Upstairs, a second primary suite opens to a Gulf-front balcony, while additional guest rooms include one with a king bed and another with two king beds and balcony views. Children will love the bunk room, outfitted with two XL twin beds and a twin-over-twin bunk. A convenient upstairs wet bar makes late-night drinks or early-morning coffee a breeze. Extras like parking for four vehicles, six adult bikes, and a low-speed vehicle make exploring Scenic 30A effortless. With its blend of modern design, upscale amenities, and an unbeatable location, Seaside Serenity is more than a vacation home, it’s a destination for unforgettable coastal memories. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 14): FIRST FLOOR - King Bed w/ Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate SECOND FLOOR - King Bed w/ Private Bathroom with Spa Shower/Tub Separate - 2 King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom with Shower Only - King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom with Shower Only - 2 XL Twin Bedroom and Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed w/ Private Bathroom with Shower Only
